criteria.name: Fleet data-center electricity (absolute)
criteria.rule: 15 = exact MWh for data-center boundary; 8 = company-wide total or rounded/floor value only; 0 = none

criteria.name: Fleet water (absolute)
criteria.rule: 15 = DC withdrawal AND consumption; 10 = DC withdrawal only; 8 = company-wide only; 0 = none

criteria.name: Per-site electricity
criteria.rule: 15 = MWh per named site/metro for most of fleet; 0 = none

criteria.name: Per-site water
criteria.rule: 15 = withdrawal+consumption per site; 10 = withdrawal per site; 0 = none

criteria.name: PUE
criteria.rule: 5 = fleet PUE with definition; +5 = per-site or regional PUE

criteria.name: WUE
criteria.rule: 5 = fleet WUE with stated basis (withdrawal vs consumption)

criteria.name: Third-party assurance
criteria.rule: 5 = energy/water metrics under stated third-party assurance; 0 = none or not found

criteria.name: Timeliness
criteria.rule: 10 = published <=7 months after period end; 5 = <=13 months; 0 = later, or latest period ended >18 months before check date

criteria.name: Boundary completeness
criteria.rule: 5 = includes leased/colocation load; 0 = owned-only or unstated

criteria.name: Published methodology
criteria.rule: 5 = definitions/estimation method stated for reported metrics
